jobs.title: Tax Equity Originator - Executive Director
jobs.description:
Why Wells Fargo

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader -we're a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job - it's about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place.

Living the Well Life means you're supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and wellbeing. You'll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we're recognized for it - Wells Fargo continues to rank on the LinkedIn Top Companies lists of best workplaces "to grow your career." Join us!

About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Tax Equity Originator - Executive Director within the Renewable Energy and Environmental Financing (REEF) group.

Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com

In This Role, You Will

Develop and manage customer relationships through all stages of our transactions, from initial bid to execution and funding
Collaborate with other parts of the bank to maximize both customer and shareholder benefit from each relationship
Lead all aspects of tax equity transaction structuring, negotiation, documentation, and diligence, developing and adapting risk mitigation tools as technologies and markets evolve
Lead cross-functional initiatives to develop new products or asset classes, enter new markets, or build new systems which create incremental revenue, increase profitability, demonstrate market leadership, capture internal efficiencies, and provide avenues for growth
Serve as a mentor and advisor to less experienced individuals
Complete work in accordance with all risk management, compliance, and business process expectations, and participate in the determination of these expectations

Required Qualifications:

7+ years of Renewable Energy Investment Origination experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, Business or related field
Experience with renewable energy finance/ tax equity investing
Project finance experience preferred
Passion for renewable energy as demonstrated either through education or work experience
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and organization, and ability to solve complex or abstract problems
Ability to contribute to projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while working effectively across internal and external stakeholders

Posting Locations:

333 Market Street San Francisco, CA
550 S. Tryon Street Charlotte, NC
51 John F Kennedy Parkway Short Hills, NJ

Salary Band by Location:

San Francisco, CA- 215,000.00 - 355,000.00 USD Annual
Charlotte, NC- 215,000.00 - 355,000.00 USD Annual
Short Hills, NJ- 215,000.00 - 355,000.00 USD Annual

Salary range is determined by location of the job. May be considered for a discretionary bonus, Restricted Share Rights, or other long-term incentive awards

#CommercialBanking

Pay Range

Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities.

$215,000.00 - $355,000.00

Benefits

Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit Benefits - Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees.

Health benefits
401(k) Plan
Paid time off
Disability benefits
Life insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance
Parental leave
Critical caregiving leave
Discounts and savings
Commuter benefits
Tuition reimbursement
Scholarships for dependent children
Adoption reimbursement

Posting End Date:

22 Aug 2026

Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit's risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Applicants With Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo .

Drug and Alcohol Policy

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

Wells Fargo Recruitment And Hiring Requirements

Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.
Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Energy Institute
jobs.description:
Posting Number:
SP005413P

Division/College:
College of Engineering

Department:
College of Engineering Admin

Location:
Moscow

Posting Context Statement

Position Overview:

As the state's land-grant university, the University of Idaho develops solutions for complex problems facing our society. The university is establishing the Energy Institute to produce the next generation of energy leaders focused on the importance of agile energy portfolio analysis and transitions. In collaboration with industry partners, the institute will strengthen the nation's energy future and workforce talent pipeline by integrating robust engineering design coursework and research into regional energy solutions. With partnerships across the region, the Energy Institute performs multi-discipline research that supports clean, reliable, affordable energy while delivering energy literacy education for students and professionals.

The Executive Director of the Energy Institute will provide institutional vision, strategy, and leadership in educational programming, research innovation, workforce development, outreach, special projects, and advocacy in the domain of energy. Reporting to the Dean of the College of Engineering in collaboration with the Office of the President, the Executive Director will provide strategic leadership in developing and recommending key goals and actions to advance energy literacy and awareness, practical solutions to gain energy independence, and sustainable (safe, reliable, economical, renewable, clean) access to energy resources. The Executive Director will work closely with an academic leadership committee, an industry advisory board, faculty, and staff to identify, develop, implement, and promote energy programming that advances the core values and strategic priorities of the university in keeping with the needs of the energy industry.

Required Experience

15 years of progressive leadership experience in the energy industry, utilities, or closely related organizations
Building partnerships and coalitions resulting in shared actions and outcomes
Experience influencing change in a complex, decentralized organization with sizeable budget, scope, and personnel
Proposal development leading to external funding
Leading teams to completion of project objectives on scope, on schedule, and on budget
Experience with utility operating environment, including regulatory, environmental, and workforce issues
Experience in the energy sector and/or energy discipline and commitment to championing energy-related causes
Collaborating with multiple entities across different sectors to deepen the public's understanding and appreciation of energy production, research, and security

Required Education

Bachelor's Degree in engineering from an ABET accredited university
Master's Degree in engineering, business administration or energy studies from an accredited university

Required Other

Professional Engineer (PE) license from Idaho or ability to obtain an Idaho PE license within the first year of hire
Completion of, or ability to complete, the University of Idaho Energy Executive Course or similar program within the first year of hire

Experience

Additional Preferred:

Demonstrated leadership of teams without direct supervisory oversight
Demonstrated skills in negotiation and conflict resolution
Experience with surveys, data collection, data analysis, and data visualization
Technical knowledge and skills related to energy, utilities, engineering, energy economics, etc.
Electric power industry experience
Non-profit board leadership experience
Experience should include industry, higher education, or government leadership – or a combination thereof
Recognized, high-level influence with a deep understanding of key issues in the energy sector
Experience with the integration of nuclear power generation into electric transmission and distribution systems

Education

PhD or terminal degree in energy, engineering, business administration, or economics or master's degree with 25 years in the energy industry
Experience working or collaborating in higher education

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

None

Degree Requirement

Listed degree qualification is required at time of hire

Exempt

Employee Category:
Exempt

$176,807 annually or more depending on experience
